description_en: Retrieves the score difference reports for a feature consistency check job
description_zh: 获取特征一致性检查任务分数报表
name: ListFeatureConsistencyCheckJobScoreReports

parameters.help_en: The ID of the feature consistency check job. To obtain the job ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557561.html
parameters.help_zh: 特征一致性检查任务报表ID。特征一致性检查任务ID。如何获取任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2557561.html
parameters.name: feature_consistency_check_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. To obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2411819.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: A list of request IDs to exclude from the feature comparison
parameters.help_zh: 特征比对时排除的RequestId列表
parameters.name: exclude_request_ids
